versions.description_html:
Learn how Microsoft Fabric Mirroring delivers near real-time database updates to OneLake in 15 seconds. Compare mirroring with shortcuts and pipelines.

Changes to your database can land in Microsoft Fabric as fast as fifteen seconds later. That is the promise of Fabric Mirroring, and it is not the same thing as copying your data once.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Why Your Data Is Stuck
  • How the Copy Actually Gets There
  • What You Get Once It's There
  • Which Sources You Can Mirror
  • Mirroring vs Shortcuts vs Pipelines
  • What It Costs and Where It Stops
  • When Mirroring Is the Right Move
  • Recap and One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM

  • Automate Real-Time Actions with Fabric Data Activator
  • More Data & Fabric episodes on M365.FM
